questions.stem: Why is hydrogen described as a 'clean' fuel?

options.text: Because it is easy to store and transport
Because it is the lightest element
Because it is cheap to produce
Because the only product of its combustion is water

questions.explanation: Hydrogen is considered a clean fuel because when it burns, the only product is water: 2H₂ + O₂ → 2H₂O. No carbon dioxide, carbon monoxide, soot, or sulfur dioxide is produced, making it free from the pollutants associated with fossil fuels.
